name: Cache URL Query Ignore
description: Alter URL cache context keys to ignore (or include only) configured query parameters, for better cache hit rates.
project_description: Cache URL Query Ignore improves the performance of the URL cache context by removing (or restricting) query parameters from the URL cache context key. It is the sibling module of Page Cache Query Ignore, which affects only the internal page cache; this module affects all usages of Drupal core's 'url' cache context (page cache, dynamic page cache, render/block caching). With core caching, https://my.site/ and https://my.site/?gclid=abc are treated as different cache entries; by listing gclid as an ignored parameter these URLs become identical to the cache, improving hit rates and reducing cache size. It works by decorating the core cache_context.url service.
